parameters.name: AgentVersion
parameters.description: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend.

parameters.name: Attachments
parameters.description: The array of image attachments. A maximum of 5 attachments are supported. Currently, only the image type is supported.

sub_parameters.name: MimeType
sub_parameters.description: The image media type. Valid values: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, and image/gif.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The attachment file name. If this parameter is not specified, the file name is obtained from OssObjectKey.

sub_parameters.name: OssObjectKey
sub_parameters.description: The OSS object key under the current user directory. The value cannot contain absolute paths or path traversal.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description: The attachment type. V2 currently supports only image.

sub_parameters.name: Url
sub_parameters.description: V2 does not support direct URL upload. Use OssObjectKey instead.

parameters.name: EnablePartialMessage
parameters.description: A compatibility field. V2 always returns event streams through SSE. The current service does not consume this field.

parameters.name: EnableThinking
parameters.description: Specifies whether to output thinking content. Default value: true. This parameter can be reset per request when re-entering the same session.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: V2 supports only IaCCodeNormal or IaCCodePipeline. The default value for a new session is IaCCodeNormal. An existing session cannot switch modes.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The user input. The value cannot be empty or contain only whitespace characters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: If this parameter is not specified, a new session is created. If this parameter is specified, the existing session of the current user is continued.
